entities.summary: Benjamin de Jesus Almoneda was a Filipino bishop of the Roman Catholic Church who served as the second bishop of the Diocese of Daet from 1991 to 2007. He also served as the first auxiliary bishop of the same diocese before becoming its ordinary.
